_comment: The renamed-Space rule (#116; consts.json spaces.renamed, test -> azure-demo), one row per input it distinguishes. Asserted by Tests/Test-HubJson.ps1 (Resolve-P20RenamedSlug, Rename-P20LegacyHubSpaces) and Tests/test_hub_json.py (renamed_slug, rename_legacy_hub_spaces) -- parity holds only for the shapes this table has. 'slugs': what an old slug a person or a file names is read as, given the Spaces that exist. 'entries': what slug a hub.json entry is read under, judged against the slugs the config ships -- a nameless entry under an old slug is a patch on the renamed shipped Space; one that names itself is a Space of its own.

slugs.why: the old slug, nothing declared under it: the new Space
a Space declared under the old slug is that Space (Tests/fixtures/hub)
a config that does not ship the new slug keeps the old one (the parity fixtures)
no Spaces at all: nothing to map to
a slug that was never renamed is itself

entries.why: a connected Example: still a patch, still nameless
an entry that names itself is a Space of its own
a config that still ships the old slug: the entry patches that
a slug that was never renamed keeps its slug
